"""Tests for the shadow-review tick selection sample."""

from subject import (
    EnumShadowDecision,
    EnumShadowStratum,
    ModelShadowReviewCandidate,
    ModelShadowReviewPolicy,
    disqualification,
    select_candidates,
    stratum_of,
)


def make_candidate(
    key,
    repo="repo_public_a",
    created_at="2026-03-01T00:00:00",
    title="Fix the flaky deploy check",
    author="alice",
    author_is_bot=False,
    watcher_class="pull_request",
    evidence_companion=False,
):
    return ModelShadowReviewCandidate(
        key=key,
        repo=repo,
        created_at=created_at,
        title=title,
        author=author,
        author_is_bot=author_is_bot,
        watcher_class=watcher_class,
        evidence_companion=evidence_companion,
    )


def make_policy(**overrides):
    fields = {
        "excluded_repos": frozenset({"repo_legacy"}),
        "public_repos": frozenset({"repo_public_a", "repo_public_b", "onex_change_control"}),
        "private_repos": frozenset({"repo_private_a"}),
        "companion_authors": frozenset({"cc-bot"}),
        "window_start": "2026-02-01T00:00:00",
        "public_cap": 60,
        "max_reviews_per_tick": 5,
    }
    fields.update(overrides)
    return ModelShadowReviewPolicy(**fields)


def summarize(rows):
    return tuple((r.key, r.stratum, r.decision, r.reason) for r in rows)


def test_stratum_of_covers_all_repositories():
    pol = make_policy()
    assert stratum_of("repo_public_a", pol) is EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC
    assert stratum_of("repo_public_b", pol) is EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC
    assert stratum_of("repo_private_a", pol) is EnumShadowStratum.PRIVATE
    assert stratum_of("repo_legacy", pol) is EnumShadowStratum.EXCLUDED
    assert stratum_of("repo_unknown", pol) is EnumShadowStratum.EXCLUDED


def test_stratum_of_exclusion_wins_over_public():
    pol = make_policy(public_repos=frozenset({"repo_legacy"}))
    assert stratum_of("repo_legacy", pol) is EnumShadowStratum.EXCLUDED


def test_disqualification_none_for_clean_candidate():
    pol = make_policy()
    assert disqualification(make_candidate("k"), pol) is None


def test_disqualification_repository_rules():
    pol = make_policy()
    assert disqualification(make_candidate("k", repo="repo_legacy"), pol) == "excluded-repository"
    assert disqualification(make_candidate("k", repo="repo_unknown"), pol) == "not-known-public"


def test_disqualification_dependency_titles():
    pol = make_policy()
    for title in (
        "chore(deps): bump flask",
        "build(deps): update toolchain",
        "Bump numpy to 2.0",
        "  deps: refresh everything",
        "chore(deps) something",
    ):
        assert disqualification(make_candidate("k", title=title), pol) == "dependency-bump"
    for title in ("Add bump protection", "deps", "rebump nothing", "Update dependencies"):
        assert disqualification(make_candidate("k", title=title), pol) is None


def test_disqualification_lockfile_refresh():
    pol = make_policy()
    assert (
        disqualification(make_candidate("k", title="Update lockfile", author_is_bot=True), pol)
        == "lockfile-refresh"
    )
    assert disqualification(make_candidate("k", title="Update lockfile"), pol) is None
    assert disqualification(make_candidate("k", author_is_bot=True), pol) is None
    assert (
        disqualification(
            make_candidate("k", title="chore(deps): lock", author_is_bot=True), pol
        )
        == "dependency-bump"
    )


def test_disqualification_change_control_companions():
    pol = make_policy()
    assert (
        disqualification(
            make_candidate("k", repo="onex_change_control", watcher_class="companion_pr"), pol
        )
        == "change-control-companion"
    )
    assert (
        disqualification(
            make_candidate("k", repo="onex_change_control", evidence_companion=True), pol
        )
        == "change-control-companion"
    )
    assert (
        disqualification(make_candidate("k", repo="onex_change_control", author="cc-bot"), pol)
        == "change-control-companion"
    )
    assert disqualification(make_candidate("k", repo="onex_change_control"), pol) is None
    assert (
        disqualification(make_candidate("k", watcher_class="companion_pr"), pol) is None
    )


def test_full_pipeline_orders_and_classifies_every_candidate():
    cands = [
        make_candidate("k_p2", repo="repo_public_b", created_at="2026-02-05T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("k_ex", repo="repo_legacy", created_at="2026-01-05T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("k_p1", repo="repo_public_a", created_at="2026-02-03T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("k_dep", created_at="2026-01-06T00:00:00", title="chore(deps): bump flask"),
        make_candidate("k_priv2", repo="repo_private_a", created_at="2026-02-07T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("k_win", created_at="2026-01-10T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("k_seen", repo="repo_public_b", created_at="2026-02-02T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("k_priv", repo="repo_private_a", created_at="2026-02-04T00:00:00"),
    ]
    pol = make_policy(public_cap=3, max_reviews_per_tick=2)
    rows = select_candidates(cands, pol, already_seen=frozenset({"k_seen"}), public_reviewed=1)
    assert isinstance(rows, tuple)
    assert summarize(rows) == (
        ("k_ex", EnumShadowStratum.EXCLUDED, EnumShadowDecision.SKIP, "excluded-repository"),
        ("k_dep", EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC, EnumShadowDecision.SKIP, "dependency-bump"),
        ("k_win", EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC, EnumShadowDecision.SKIP, "created-before-window"),
        ("k_seen", EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC, EnumShadowDecision.SKIP, "already-in-store"),
        ("k_p1", EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC, EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW, "qualifying"),
        ("k_priv", EnumShadowStratum.PRIVATE, EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW, "qualifying"),
        ("k_p2", EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC, EnumShadowDecision.SKIP, "deferred-next-tick"),
        ("k_priv2", EnumShadowStratum.PRIVATE, EnumShadowDecision.SKIP, "deferred-next-tick"),
    )

    rows = select_candidates(cands, pol, already_seen=frozenset(), public_reviewed=0)

        ("p1", EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC, EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW, "qualifying"),
        ("p2", EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC, EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW, "qualifying"),
        ("p3", EnumShadowStratum.PUBLIC, EnumShadowDecision.SKIP, "sample-complete"),
        ("v1", EnumShadowStratum.PRIVATE, EnumShadowDecision.SKIP, "sample-complete"),

def test_private_reviews_do_not_consume_public_cap():
    pol = make_policy(public_cap=1, max_reviews_per_tick=5)
    cands = [
        make_candidate("v1", repo="repo_private_a", created_at="2026-02-10T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("v2", repo="repo_private_a", created_at="2026-02-11T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("p1", repo="repo_public_a", created_at="2026-02-12T00:00:00"),
        make_candidate("p2", repo="repo_public_b", created_at="2026-02-13T00:00:00"),

        ("v2", EnumShadowStratum.PRIVATE, EnumShadowDecision.REVIEW, "qualifying"),
